violated_contract: A retrying delivery must retain custody until its work is durably settled or a live successor owns the remaining work. Cloud Tasks can reject a task name after the task itself no longer exists.
canonical_prevention: Require a confirmed future task before acknowledging a retry handoff. Treat a retained name or an inconclusive lookup as an unconfirmed handoff. A successor reloads persisted work under its own lease and preserves the original pending age.
